Episode 127 advances the Bride of Charlie series' preliminary-hearing record by presenting six discrete evidentiary exhibits drawn from on-air testimony and recorded interviews. The most structurally significant artifacts are the read-aloud exchanges from Officer Bagley's preliminary hearing (body-cam termination and unidentified rooftop companion), the email from a credentialed Axon Body Cam 4 operator disputing the body-cam battery explanation, the joint testimony of Sergeant Jennifer Faumuina (Utah Bureau of Investigations) and FBI agent Amanda Bakker concerning the abandoned backpack/jacket/gloves that were located on the suspect's route and then removed from FBI testing, the recorded Frank Turek FaceTime interview in which he visibly shifts his stated endpoint from "hotel" to "hospital," and a played excerpt of Dan Bongino on Megyn Kelly (Sept 15, 2025) describing the screwdriver rooftop footage as grainy.

The episode's investigative contributions are concentrated in three structural questions: (1) who was on the Losee Center rooftop between 12:23 and 12:44 and how that person's badge was verified; (2) the chain of communication by which a backpack found along the shooter route was reclassified as "Kirk's detail" without testing; and (3) the inconsistencies in Frank Turek's account of his FaceTime call during the incident. A separate tip from a verified Timpanogos Regional Hospital source advances the hospital-pre-notification question. No new evidentiary artifacts are introduced in the comments section; that material is non-investigative.

blocks.header: **C-10867** Officer Bagley Testified Body-Cam Footage Ended While on Rooftop
blocks.label: Officer Bagley Testified Body-Cam Footage Ended While on Rooftop

lines.v: Officer Bagley testified that his Axon body-cam footage, which the examiner described as 27 minutes and 35 seconds long, ended while he was still on the Losee Center roof, and said "I think his battery went dead."
Obtain full Axon Body Cam 4 battery-log metadata for Bagley's device on Sept. 10, 2025, including dock-cycle history.

blocks.header: **C-10871** Officer Bagley testified he did not know the identity of his rooftop companion
blocks.label: Officer Bagley testified he did not know the identity of his rooftop companion

lines.v: Officer Bagley testified that he was accompanied on the Losee Center rooftop by an unidentified individual in civilian clothing who had a badge and a handgun, and whose agency he did not know.
Identify the badge-holder from rooftop footage, radio traffic logs, and officer roster records for Sept. 10, 2025.

blocks.header: **C-10873** Officer Bagley testified he did not review video footage between 12:23 and 12:44 for other rooftop presence
blocks.label: Officer Bagley testified he did not review video footage between 12:23 and 12:44 for other rooftop presence

lines.v: Officer Bagley testified that he did not notice anyone else on the roof and, asked whether he checked the video for that gap of time, answered "In that gap of time, no"; the examiner summarized that he did not review the video for anyone on the rooftop between the suspect's jump and his arrival.
Locate the 20-minute footage gap referenced and obtain any UVU or law-enforcement video from that window.

blocks.header: **C-10869** Axon Body Cam 4 operator email disputes battery termination claim
blocks.label: Axon Body Cam 4 operator email disputes battery termination claim

lines.v: An email from a police officer using the same Axon Body Cam 4 model states that the camera battery lasts approximately 14 hours, that cameras are docked at the end of every shift on a shared dock that uploads the data and videos to the server, and that it bothered him that the officer claimed his camera died on the rooftop.
Identify the email author (host has protected identity), corroborate Axon Body Cam 4 specifications from manufacturer documentation, and request Bagley's device telemetry.

blocks.header: **C-10879** Sergeant Faumuina testified backpack, jacket, and gloves were found at Fulton Library bus stop on shooter's route
blocks.label: Sergeant Faumuina testified backpack, jacket, and gloves were found at Fulton Library bus stop on shooter's route

lines.v: Sergeant Jennifer Faumuina of the Utah Bureau of Investigations testified that officers canvassing the scene, including the shooter's route, found unattended items at the Fulton Library bus stops, and that a backpack, jacket and gloves were seized.
Obtain Faumuina's September 22, 2025 crime-scene overview report and the seizure item numbers she could not recall.

blocks.header: **C-10882** Sergeant Faumuina testified items were sent to FBI lab for DNA processing
blocks.label: Sergeant Faumuina testified items were sent to FBI lab for DNA processing

lines.v: Sergeant Faumuina testified that the seized items were sent to the FBI lab for DNA and other analysis, along with information that the suspect may have shed items as he fled.
Obtain the FBI lab intake documentation for these items and the chain-of-custody record.

blocks.header: **C-10883** Sergeant Faumuina testified that testing was halted without her direct communication of the decision
blocks.label: Sergeant Faumuina testified that testing was halted without her direct communication of the decision

lines.v: Sergeant Faumuina testified that when the items were already sent investigators had no more information on whether they were probative, that she did not remember communicating to the lab that no further testing was needed, and that it would not be inconsistent with what she knew if FBI or ATF notes said so.
Compare FBI/ATF lab notes to Faumuina's communication log and identify the party that actually conveyed the "not probative" determination.

blocks.header: **C-10887** FBI agent Amanda Bakker testified backpack was determined to be potentially left by a bystander
blocks.label: FBI agent Amanda Bakker testified backpack was determined to be potentially left by a bystander

lines.v: FBI agent Amanda Bakker testified that the backpack (exhibit 9) was determined to be "potentially left behind by a bystander" and that no DNA comparisons were needed at that time.
Identify the bystander candidate; obtain the source of the "bystander" classification.

blocks.header: **C-10889** Amanda Bakker testified lab notes attributed backpack to Kirk's detail via another lab employee's communication
blocks.label: Amanda Bakker testified lab notes attributed backpack to Kirk's detail via another lab employee's communication

lines.v: FBI agent Amanda Bakker testified, when confronted with lab notes stating the backpack "belongs to Kirk's detailees," that this language was not from her communication log and that it was information another individual within the laboratory received.
Identify the lab employee who authored/added the "Kirk's detail" attribution; obtain that employee's written communication.

blocks.header: **C-10890** Host stance: FBI "bystander/Kirk's detail" determination is unsubstantiated
blocks.label: Host stance: FBI "bystander/Kirk's detail" determination is unsubstantiated

lines.v: The host says Sergeant Faumuina does not remember communicating the "not probative" decision and that Bakker says someone else in the lab added the "Kirk's detail" note, asks who that person is, and says the items should have been tested.
Locate the original handwritten or digital lab note and trace the attribution chain.

blocks.header: **C-10908** Frank Turek stated he was FaceTiming his son and daughter-in-law during the event
blocks.label: Frank Turek stated he was FaceTiming his son and daughter-in-law during the event

lines.v: Frank Turek stated on the played interview that he was FaceTiming his son and daughter-in-law when the shot rang out and continued the call until reaching the hospital, with the phone in his back pocket for the duration.
Obtain call-detail records (timestamps, duration, devices) for the FaceTime session.

blocks.header: **C-10909** Frank Turek Corrects Himself From Hotel to Hospital on FaceTime Duration
blocks.label: Frank Turek Corrects Himself From Hotel to Hospital on FaceTime Duration

lines.v: In a played clip, Frank Turek says he never said he was on FaceTime for 9 hours and that someone online said he said he was on FaceTime "till we got to the hotel. No, to the hospital"; the host then says her team tracked down the person who said hotel and plays a clip.
Obtain the full unedited interview recordings and any prior statements Turek made on this point.

blocks.header: **C-10923** Dan Bongino stated on Sept. 15 that screwdriver rooftop footage was too grainy to discern
blocks.label: Dan Bongino stated on Sept. 15 that screwdriver rooftop footage was too grainy to discern

lines.v: Host describes watching Dan Bongino state on Megyn Kelly's show on September 15, 2025, that the screwdriver rooftop footage was too grainy for the FBI's tools to clarify, establishing a baseline against later influencer characterizations of the same footage as "crystal clear."
Obtain the original Megyn Kelly / Bongino Sept. 15 broadcast and any FBI enhancement documentation released between Sept. 15 and the influencer court-day coverage.

blocks.header: **C-10905** Anonymous husband letter claims wife's Candace-influenced beliefs are causing marriage strain
blocks.label: Anonymous husband letter claims wife's Candace-influenced beliefs are causing marriage strain

lines.v: A letter read on Frank Turek's show by an anonymous husband states that his wife has become "deeply influenced by Candace Owens' recent content" regarding Turek, Israel, and conspiracy topics, and that this is creating a widening divide in their marriage.
Note as Frank Turek show content artifact; not investigation-relevant. Preserve for record only.

blocks.header: **C-10895** Verified Timpanogos Regional Hospital source states hospital was not pre-informed
blocks.label: Verified Timpanogos Regional Hospital source states hospital was not pre-informed

lines.v: A source verified by host as a Timpanogos Regional Hospital employee told the host that the hospital was not informed ahead of time that Charlie Kirk was en route, contrary to the official 911-call-and-pre-notification narrative.
(no on-air displayed/recorded artifact from source; reliance on host description)
Obtain independent corroboration from hospital intake records, EMS radio traffic, and any 911-call recordings reflecting pre-arrival coordination.
